generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `insertValue` method throws an `IllegalStateException` when `suffixMaps.isEmpty()`, which is unexpected since the comment suggests this should never happen. Consider adding a more descriptive error message or handling this case differently to avoid confusion.
The test cases in these methods are similar and could be refactored into parameterized tests to reduce redundancy and improve readability.

In the `getMapValue` method, the use of `Arrays.copyOfRange(pathElements, 0, i)` can lead to an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` if `i` is greater than the length of `pathElements`. Ensure that `i` does not exceed the array bounds.

The `extractSuffixMaps` method is recursive and can lead to stack overflow if the depth of nested structures is very large. Consider using an iterative approach or increasing the stack size as a workaround. The `suffixMaps.addAll(extractSuffixMaps(pathElements, index + 1, map.get(key)));` line can lead to unnecessary recursive calls if `map.get(key)` returns null. This should be checked before making the recursive call.

The change in this diff from `newDocMap.put(fieldName, result);` to `XContentMapValues.insertValue(fieldName, newDocMap, result);` assumes that `insertValue` handles all cases correctly. Verify that `insertValue` can handle all possible structures of `fieldName` and `result`.

review_comment:
We got a two-for-one with this bug fix 😁 

Since the semantic text field type adds sub-objects to the mapping upon first document ingestion, it cannot be in an object field with subobjects disabled. Before this fix, doing so resulted in Very Bad Things™, such as the [document parser handling inference sub-fields as runtime fields and triggering assertion failures](https://github.com/Mikep86/elasticsearch/blob/516aa119453d97ec7ac58292e8a91642a5d75893/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/DocumentParser.java#L1039-L1039).
